data.title: DSI refers second Stark case to attorney-general
data.description: <p>The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) has referred a second money-laundering case involving Stark Corporation (STARK) to the Office of the Attorney-General (OAG), whose ruling will determine jurisdiction over the transfer of 743 million baht to Singapore.</p>

data.title: Court set to rule on ballot secrecy row
data.description: <p>The Constitutional Court will rule on Sept 28 on whether barcodes and QR codes printed on ballot papers used in the Feb 8 general election breached constitutional protections for secret voting.</p>

data.title: Senate probe leak sparks legal action
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Wednesday backed legal action against those responsible for leaking documents from an investigation into alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election.</p>

data.title: Meta, US states agree $16.7 bn settlement in landmark teen safety case
data.description: SAN FRANCISCO (UNITED STATES) - Meta agreed to pay a coalition of US states as much as $16.7 billion and to impose sweeping new limits on how teenagers use Facebook and Instagram, according to a court filing on Wednesday that ends a landmark trial in California.

data.title: The foreign tourists missing in Nepal's flash floods
data.description: KATHMANDU (NEPAL) - Hundreds of tourists in Nepal, many of them foreigners, have gone missing in the Himalayan nation's devastating flash floods on Wednesday, which have killed at least 95 people.

data.title: Vegetables pass formalin test after Chinese scare
data.description: <p>The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has found no formalin contamination in 42 vegetable samples tested in the wake of reports of formalin being used on Chinese cabbage.</p>

data.title: Thais 'lag in using AI for work'
data.description: <p>Thailand has the world's highest usage of Google's Gemini Nano Banana for image generation, indicating a high level of creativity among Thai users. However, the country still lags behind its neighbours in using AI to boost productivity and economic value.</p>

data.title: Task force denies helicopter shots
data.description: <p>The Narathiwat Task Force has rejected reports that troops fired an M16 rifle from a helicopter at a group of youths in Chanae district, saying personnel carried no weapons during the surveillance mission.</p>

data.title: B57bn sought for southern projects
data.description: <p>Nearly 200 projects worth more than 57 billion baht have been proposed by five southern border provinces ahead of next week's mobile cabinet meeting in Hat Yai district of Songkhla.</p>

data.title: PM urges focus on upskilling
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has called for closer Asean cooperation to upgrade workers' skills in response to rapid advances in artificial intelligence, the green economy and demographic change, while promoting an Asean Digital Skills Passport to facilitate cross-border employment.</p>

data.title: Cyber cops seize guns in online crackdown
data.description: <p>Cyber police have arrested 186 people and seized 228 firearms, 1,294 rounds of ammunition and an improvised explosive device in a nationwide crackdown on illegal online gun trading.</p>

data.title: Energy crisis 'drives loan'
data.description: <p>Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has defended the government's 400-billion-baht emergency loan decree as essential to economic security as the energy crisis pushes the current-account deficit towards 600 billion baht.</p>

data.title: Nigerian armed groups net nearly $6 mn in ransoms: study
data.description: ABUJA - Criminal groups in Nigeria raised nearly $6 million in ransom payments in the last year, a report said Wednesday, with two mass kidnappings by Boko Haram responsible for nearly 90 percent of the total.

data.title: How narwhal 'scientists' track Arctic warming
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The fight against climate change has a new, spiral-tusked ally: the narwhal.

data.title: Brazil sues Discord over child safety measures, demands $100 mln in damages
data.description: RIO DE JANEIRO (BRAZIL) - The Brazilian government on Wednesday filed a lawsuit to force the Discord messaging platform to adopt stronger measures to protect children, and is seeking almost $100 million in "collective moral damages."

data.title: Iran says US sanctions will achieve nothing
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran's president insisted on Wednesday that the United States would achieve nothing with its new sanctions campaign after Washington laid out plans to collapse the country's economy.

data.title: Fake school shooting threat a cover for a late delivery
data.description: RATCHABURI - Officials closed a school serving 3,000 students on Wednesday after receiving a shooting threat, only to find out later that a sports day jersey supplier had used it to postpone a delivery.

data.title: Dozens dead in catastrophic Nepal-Tibet floods
data.description: Hundreds missing as torrents of water and mud wash away buildings in border region

data.title: Abhisit says borrowing B400 billion won’t spur growth
data.description: Democrat Party leader Abhisit Vejjajiva has outlined four reasons for rejecting an emergency decree authorising the government to borrow 400 billion baht, warning that its passage would do little to change Thailand’s economic growth prospects while leaving people exposed to an ongoing energy crisis.

data.title: Prince Harry and family arrive back in Britain
data.description: LONDON - Prince Harry, his wife Meghan and their two children landed Wednesday in Britain, UK media reported, after the surprise news emerged last week they would be relocating from the United States.

data.title: Nile crocodiles in France hatch unaided amid heatwave
data.description: LYON - The heatwaves that have beset France have produced an unusual outcome at a wildlife park, where 10 Nile crocodiles hatched without human assistance for the first time, the director of the reserve said on Wednesday.

data.title: Suvarnabhumi road maintenance to disrupt traffic
data.description: Suvarnabhumi airport in Bangkok has advised passengers to plan their journeys in advance and allow extra travel time as a maintenance project will block some traffic lanes to and from the passenger terminal from next Monday to April 7 of next year.

data.title: 32 villagers fined for stealing shrimp from crashed truck
data.description: Thirty-two residents of Lampang have been fined 10,000 baht each for stealing almost 1.2 tonnes of shrimp worth around 300,000 baht from a truck after it crashed in Thoen district in the northern province in March.

data.title: France eases cow diet rules to help cheesemakers
data.description: PARIS - Widespread drought and record-breaking heatwaves have forced France to relax some of its famously strict rules on cheese production, with authorities on Wednesday announcing special measures for abondance, beaufort and comte cheeses.

data.title: Nepal floods kill eight, cause ‘major casualties’ in Tibet
data.description: NUWAKOT, Nepal - Massive flooding killed eight people in Nepal on Wednesday as Chinese state media reported “major casualties” from a mudslide at a Tibet trade hub on China’s side of the nations’ shared border.

data.title: MDES-depa celebrates success of coding Thailand 2026
data.description: The Ministry of Digital Economy and Society (MDES), through the Digital Economy Promotion Agency (depa), has announced the success of Coding Thailand 2026: AI Inspires the Future, a project aimed at promoting coding and artificial intelligence (AI) skills among Thai students and teachers nationwide. More than 12,000 students and teachers from across the country registered toparticipatein the project. After completing a series of learning activities and knowledge assessments, 3,224 participants from 806 teams were selected to take part in the regional competitions.
